UWIB Risk is an organization built on the idea of partnership: We partner with our clients to achieve the best results for their businesses, employees, and families. We partner with others in the insurance industry to drive technological innovation in the InsurTech space. We partner with each of our team members to empower career growth and personal & professional fulfillment.  

We are always looking to expand and grow our partnerships in any of these directions, or others that we may not have even thought of! If you believe there’s a partnership opportunity, reach out to us today.

## PARTNERING WITH EMPLOYEES FOR SHARED SUCCESS

We are growing! UWIB Risk is always looking for great people to join our team. Whether you have only a few years of experience, or a few decades, we’d love to hear from you.

Unlike other insurance agencies of our size (and even larger), we are committed to growing our business for the benefit of our own family, and our employees and their families—not to sell our agency and its staff to the highest bidder. That means UWIB provides a long-term future for our team members and the culture you find when you join us will be the culture that grows along with you.

## PARTNERING WITH AGENCIES FOR SHARED OPPORTUNITY

As members of the $2+ Billion Dollar PIIB cooperative of agencies, we work together to achieve combined buying power, innovation, and infrastructure.

UWIB Risk receives the advantages of a much larger organization while able to provide our clients the personalized service they should expect from a boutique white-glove firm such as ours.

<Callout variant="button-link">

[ENROLL YOUR AGENCY](/agency-worksheet)

</Callout>

## PARTNERING WITH OTHER PROFESSIONALS FOR THE BENEFIT OF CLIENTS

At UWIB Risk, we’re experts in assessing risk and finding solutions to help reduce it. However, we are not attorneys, accountants, or investment advisors. As we serve some of the nation’s top businesses and high-wealth individuals, we are constantly seeking partnerships with other professionals to enhance our clients’ experience and outcomes.

If you are a professional seeking to provide a referral to a highly-trusted insurance professional, we’d love to talk.
